big.description: Whether to use the big tag style

value.description: Value of the tag, used as the inner text or HTML in lieu of children

color.description: Color variant for a noninteractive tag. Linked tags use theme link color.

outline.description: Use a transparent background with border. Linked tags always use the outline style.

icon.description: Name of the icon to display before the tag text, from the USWDS sprite (e.g., 'check', 'close', 'warning', etc.)

dismissible.description: Whether to render a dismiss button inside the tag.

onDismiss.description: Optional inline JavaScript to run when the dismiss button is clicked. If omitted, the tag removes itself from the DOM.

href.description: Optional destination. When supplied, Tag renders a link; otherwise it renders a span.

target.description: Anchor target when href is set.

rel.description: Anchor relationship when href is set.

extraAttributes.description: Additional HTML attributes, including data attributes, applied to the rendered tag element.

className.description: Additional classes to add to the tag

children.description: Inner HTML or text for the tag
